dialogues.en: ...What a nuisance!
dialogues.text: ...What a nuisance!

dialogues.en: Extending my arm, I fumble for the switch.
dialogues.text: Extending my arm, I fumble for the switch.

dialogues.jp: ……うるさい。
手を伸ばし、手探りでスイッチを見つける。

dialogues.en: ---- Knock knock.
dialogues.text: ---- Knock knock.

dialogues.jp: ――コンコン
dialogues.en: Click.
dialogues.text: Click.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん、いつまでねてるんです！？　起きて
　ください」
dialogues.en:
"Niisan, are you going to sleep all day!? It's time to get
up."
dialogues.text:
"Niisan, are you going to sleep all day!? It's time to get
up."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うーん……」

ゆらゆらとした揺れを感じ、うっすらと目を開
ける。
dialogues.en: Feeling a whirling sensation, I open my eyes slightly.
dialogues.text: Feeling a whirling sensation, I open my eyes slightly.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ……今日から休みだろ……」
dialogues.en: "Why did you wake me up?... We're on vacation now..."
dialogues.text: "Why did you wake me up?... We're on vacation now..."

dialogues.jp: ズレた布団を掛け直す。
dialogues.en: I pull my blanket up.
dialogues.text: I pull my blanket up.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もう……『音楽部の手伝いをすることになっ
　たから起こせ』って言ったのは兄さんでしょ
　う？」
dialogues.en:
"Come on... You're the one who told me to wake you up
because you're going to help the music club."
dialogues.text:
"Come on... You're the one who told me to wake you up
because you're going to help the music club."

dialogues.jp: そうか……眞子と。
dialogues.en: Oh yeah... with Mako.
dialogues.text: Oh yeah... with Mako.

dialogues.jp: はぁ……。
dialogues.en: Whoa...
dialogues.text: Whoa...

dialogues.jp: むくりと起き上がり、ぐっと伸びをする。
dialogues.en: I sit up abruptly and stretch.
dialogues.text: I sit up abruptly and stretch.

dialogues.jp: 「……おはよう」
dialogues.en: "......Good morning."
dialogues.text: "......Good morning."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まったくもう……」
ふぅ、と息をついて、音夢が腰に手をあてる。
dialogues.en: Drawing a sigh, Nemu puts her hands on her waist.
dialogues.text: Drawing a sigh, Nemu puts her hands on her waist.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん、また何か企んでるんじゃないでしょ
　うね？」
dialogues.en: "Niisan, you aren't up to something again, are you?"
dialogues.text: "Niisan, you aren't up to something again, are you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「んなことないって」
dialogues.en: "Of course not."
dialogues.text: "Of course not."

dialogues.jp: 朝イチからそれか……。
dialogues.en: How can she be like this so early in the morning...?
dialogues.text: How can she be like this so early in the morning...?

dialogues.jp:
「少なくとも、おまえが危惧するようなことは
　企んでいないから安心しろ」
dialogues.en:
"Or at least, I'm not doing anything that'll make you
nervous, so don't worry about me."
dialogues.text:
"Or at least, I'm not doing anything that'll make you
nervous, so don't worry about me."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「とにかく早く起きてくださいね。下で待って
　ますから」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, get ready. I'm gonna be waiting for you
downstairs."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, get ready. I'm gonna be waiting for you
downstairs."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「らじゃ」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: 次第に遠くなる鈴の音。
dialogues.en: The sound of her bell fades away.
dialogues.text: The sound of her bell fades away.

dialogues.jp:
廊下を歩く足音が聞こえなくなってから、布団
からはいでる。
dialogues.en:
After Nemu's footsteps walking down the hallway fade to
silence, I crawl out of bed.
dialogues.text:
After Nemu's footsteps walking down the hallway fade to
silence, I crawl out of bed.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁぁ……むちゃくちゃ眠いぞ」
dialogues.en: "Ah......I'm so sleepy."
dialogues.text: "Ah......I'm so sleepy."

dialogues.jp:
なんとか眠気をこらえて制服の袖に腕を通すと、
いつものように鞄をかついで家を出る。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いこっ、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Let's go, niisan."
dialogues.text: "Let's go, niisan."

dialogues.jp: 外で待っていた音夢が、空を見上げて微笑む。
dialogues.en:
Nemu, who was waiting for me outside the house, looks up at
the sky and smiles.
dialogues.text:
Nemu, who was waiting for me outside the house, looks up at
the sky and smiles.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「今日も晴れてよかったね」
dialogues.en: "Bright and sunny again."
dialogues.text: "Bright and sunny again."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……そうだな」

足取り軽く進んでいく音夢の後を、｛うつ／鬱｝な気分で
ついていく。
dialogues.en:
Nemu walks along light-footedly, and I follow her in a
gloomy mood.
dialogues.text:
Nemu walks along light-footedly, and I follow her in a
gloomy mood.

dialogues.jp:
家を出てからずっと、今日からのことについて
考える。
dialogues.en:
I've been thinking since I left the house about my life
starting from today.
dialogues.text:
I've been thinking since I left the house about my life
starting from today.

dialogues.jp: 「恋人か……」
dialogues.en: "Being Mako's boyfriend......"
dialogues.text: "Being Mako's boyfriend......"

dialogues.jp: どう接したらいいんだ？
dialogues.en: How should I treat her?
dialogues.text: How should I treat her?

dialogues.jp:
どうにも、その手の人生経験が不足している気
がする。
dialogues.en: I feel I don't have enough experience in that field.
dialogues.text: I feel I don't have enough experience in that field.

dialogues.jp: （わからん……）
dialogues.en: (I have no idea.)
dialogues.text: (I have no idea.)

dialogues.jp: 「おじゃましま〜す……」
dialogues.en: "Hi, everyone......"
dialogues.text: "Hi, everyone......"

dialogues.jp: そろそろ――と扉を開けて、音楽室に入る。
dialogues.en: Slowly opening the door, I step into the music room.
dialogues.text: Slowly opening the door, I step into the music room.

dialogues.jp:
手伝うことになっているとはいえ、部外者の人
間が部活に参加するのは、少々緊張する。
dialogues.en:
I know I'm supposed to be here to help the club, but I'm a
little nervous because I'm attending the club without being
an official member.
dialogues.text:
I know I'm supposed to be here to help the club, but I'm a
little nervous because I'm attending the club without being
an official member.

dialogues.jp: 俺の姿を見た眞子が、俺から視線をそらす。
dialogues.en:
Mako had turned to watch me, but now she turns her eyes away
from me.
dialogues.text:
Mako had turned to watch me, but now she turns her eyes away
from me.

dialogues.jp:
（おいおい、恋人の関係を見せるんじゃなかっ
　たのか？）
dialogues.en:
(Come on, you're supposed to show everyone that we're
dating.)
dialogues.text:
(Come on, you're supposed to show everyone that we're
dating.)

dialogues.jp: 視線をそらしてどうする……。
dialogues.en: You shouldn't turn your eyes away from me...
dialogues.text: You shouldn't turn your eyes away from me...

dialogues.jp:
眞子にどう話しかけるか迷い、入口で立ち尽く
す形になる。
dialogues.en:
Feeling unsure what to say to Mako, I stand rooted to the
entrance of the room.
dialogues.text:
Feeling unsure what to say to Mako, I stand rooted to the
entrance of the room.

dialogues.jp:
他の部員が気を利かせて、俺を部屋に招き入れ
てくれた。
dialogues.en:
Another member of the club shows pity on me and invites me
into the room.
dialogues.text:
Another member of the club shows pity on me and invites me
into the room.

dialogues.en: "What's up......?"
dialogues.text: "What's up......?"

dialogues.jp:
音楽室の中に案内され、俺はさりげなく眞子に
近づく。
dialogues.en: Escorted inside the music room, I casually approach Mako.
dialogues.text: Escorted inside the music room, I casually approach Mako.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「お、おはよう」
dialogues.en: "Goo, good morning."
dialogues.text: "Goo, good morning."

dialogues.jp: はっきり言って……ぎこちない。
dialogues.en: Oh, boy... She's so awkward.
dialogues.text: Oh, boy... She's so awkward.

dialogues.jp:
「何どもってるんだよ……こっちまで緊張が伝
　わってくるじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "Don't stutter...... You're making me nervous, too."
dialogues.text: "Don't stutter...... You're making me nervous, too."

dialogues.jp: 眞子の隣に座り、そっと｛ささや／囁｝く。
dialogues.en: Sitting next to Mako, I whisper tenderly.
dialogues.text: Sitting next to Mako, I whisper tenderly.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「べ、別に緊張なんかしてないわよ」
dialogues.en: "Uh, I'm not nervous."
dialogues.text: "Uh, I'm not nervous."

dialogues.jp: 言って、眞子が口元に手をやる。
dialogues.en: Having said that, Mako covers her mouth with her hand.
dialogues.text: Having said that, Mako covers her mouth with her hand.

dialogues.jp:
会話が続かない。しかも視線まで逸らされたら、
話しかけにくいじゃないか。
dialogues.en:
No conversation. Not only that, it's difficult to talk to
you if you're averting your eyes from me.
dialogues.text:
No conversation. Not only that, it's difficult to talk to
you if you're averting your eyes from me.

dialogues.jp: これじゃあ、恋人どころか嫌われ者……。
dialogues.en: I'm like a skunk rather than her boyfriend...
dialogues.text: I'm like a skunk rather than her boyfriend...

dialogues.jp: 俺はその場しのぎに、室内を見渡す。
dialogues.en: I look over the room in a makeshift manner.
dialogues.text: I look over the room in a makeshift manner.

dialogues.jp:
室内にいるのは、ほとんどが女の子で、作業の
段取りや、準備なんかをしているらしい。
dialogues.en:
Most of the people in the room are girls, and they look like
they are preparing for music performance.
dialogues.text:
Most of the people in the room are girls, and they look like
they are preparing for music performance.

dialogues.jp: 「なぁ、眞子」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Mako."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Mako."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「な、なによ」
dialogues.en: "Wha, what?"
dialogues.text: "Wha, what?"

dialogues.jp: 肩をビクッとして、硬い声で返事をする。
dialogues.en:
Mako straightens her shoulders with a start and replies in a
stiff voice.
dialogues.text:
Mako straightens her shoulders with a start and replies in a
stiff voice.

dialogues.jp: ったく、変に意識しすぎだぞ。
dialogues.en: You're making too big a deal of this.
dialogues.text: You're making too big a deal of this.

dialogues.jp: 「音楽部ってこんなに男子、少ないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you guys have only a few boys in the music club?"
dialogues.text: "Do you guys have only a few boys in the music club?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、それはあんたと一緒よ。面倒臭がって
　不参加なだけ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah...... Many boys are too lazy to join, just like you."
dialogues.text: "Yeah...... Many boys are too lazy to join, just like you."

dialogues.jp: なるほど。まあ、自由参加だからな。
dialogues.en: I see. Well, this is an optional activity.
dialogues.text: I see. Well, this is an optional activity.

dialogues.jp: 「で、俺は何をすればいいんだ？」
dialogues.en: "So what do I have to do?"
dialogues.text: "So what do I have to do?"

dialogues.jp:
一応、手伝いという名目で来てるわけだから、
何かしないとな。
dialogues.en:
Since I'm meant to have come here to help, I have to do
something.
dialogues.text:
Since I'm meant to have come here to help, I have to do
something.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「とりあえず楽器出すの手伝ってくれる？」
dialogues.en: "Well, could you bring the musical instruments?"
dialogues.text: "Well, could you bring the musical instruments?"

dialogues.jp: 準備室の方を指して言う。
dialogues.en: Mako said while pointing to the preparatory room.
dialogues.text: Mako said while pointing to the preparatory room.

dialogues.jp: 荷物運びか。かったるいな。
dialogues.en: Carrying stuff. That sucks.
dialogues.text: Carrying stuff. That sucks.

dialogues.jp: まあ、そのための男手か……。
dialogues.en: Well, I'm here to give a male hand...
dialogues.text: Well, I'm here to give a male hand...

dialogues.jp: ◆音楽部の手伝い◆

恋人のフリ、ということで、眞子の手伝いをす
ることになってしまった俺。
音楽部の文化祭準備を手伝った。
